headline: A big play for Indianapolis
what_happened: D.Jones threw a long pass to L.Treadwell that moved Indianapolis 48 yards down the field.
why_it_matters: This is tough news for the Chiefs as it helps Indianapolis get much closer to scoring. It significantly increases the chances of Indianapolis winning this game.
pop_culture: The referees reversed a call that would have ended the game, and Taylor Swift was spotted looking frustrated in her suite.
